#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""check_queue_wait.py - p90 time CI jobs wait for a runner, over the last 15 minutes.

Thresholds are read from queue_wait.yaml next to this file (deployed from rhpds/rhdp-monitoring
together with the plugin). Each pool has its own entry. If the file is absent the built-in
defaults below are used, and nothing in the output says so.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from ci_metrics import p90_wait_seconds

CONFIG = Path(__file__).with_name("queue_wait.yaml")
DEFAULT_WARN_S = 120
DEFAULT_CRIT_S = 240


def thresholds(pool):
    if not CONFIG.exists():
        return DEFAULT_WARN_S, DEFAULT_CRIT_S
    conf = yaml.safe_load(CONFIG.read_text())["pools"][pool]
    return conf["warn_seconds"], conf["crit_seconds"]


def main():
    pool = sys.argv[1]
    warn, crit = thresholds(pool)
    wait = p90_wait_seconds(pool, minutes=15)
    perf = f"p90_wait={wait}s;{warn};{crit};0"
    if wait > crit:
        print(f"QUEUE_WAIT CRITICAL - p90 job wait {wait} s over 15 min (crit {crit} s)|{perf}"); sys.exit(2)
    if wait > warn:
        print(f"QUEUE_WAIT WARNING - p90 job wait {wait} s over 15 min (warn {warn} s)|{perf}"); sys.exit(1)
    print(f"QUEUE_WAIT OK - p90 job wait {wait} s over 15 min|{perf}"); sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
